request: an SVG animation of a pelican riding a bike
thesis: A pelican's absurd anatomy (huge pouched bill, tiny legs, stubby body) forced onto a bicycle's mechanics is funny only if the pedalling, wheels and balance actually work.
job: open page and see the scene already moving
recognise pelican and bike at a glance
watch pedalling, spinning wheels, bobbing body, moving scenery
see state change (button label, speed readout)
optionally honk/flap or toggle a detail

tricks: offset phase of body bob at 2x pedal frequency
tests: does the foot stay on the pedal

tricks: compute leg two-bone IK in JS so feet track pedals
spokes via stroke-dasharray or rotated lines
requestAnimationFrame with a time variable for pause

principles: wheels rotate in proportion to ground speed
chain connects crank to rear wheel
tricks: counter-rotate pedals so they stay horizontal

parts: pelican: long bill with pouch, round eye, white body, wing, tail, tiny legs and webbed feet
bike: two spoked wheels, frame, fork, handlebar, saddle, crank, pedals, chain
expectations: pelican sits on saddle, wing on handlebar, feet on pedals

kinds.name: side-view cartoon on a scrolling road
cyclist in a race with finish line

descriptions: bill about 40 percent of body length, orange-yellow with a hooked tip, pouch sagging below
wheels large and thin, body small on top
pelican off-white with grey wing edge
bike in a saturated contrast colour
far layers move slower than near
behaviors: pause freezes everything at current phase

anti_keywords.not: static drawing with only one CSS spin
anti_keywords.instead: legs driven by crank angle so knees bend and feet track pedals

anti_keywords.not: pedals rotating with the crank like a fan
wheels spinning while ground stands still
anti_keywords.instead: road marks and scenery scroll at wheel speed

anti_keywords.not: generic duck or seagull with a tiny beak
anti_keywords.instead: huge pouched bill dominates the silhouette
pause and speed update animation and visible readout

checks: open with no click: it moves
pause button changes label and freezes
speed slider changes wheel rate and readout
built: side-view cartoon on a scrolling road
